scope: Primary-source interpretation guidance; product identity and aggregation settings must be checked against local NetCDF and retrieval metadata.

swvl1.name: Volumetric soil water layer 1
swvl1.caveat: Model soil moisture, not a Sentinel-2 optical measurement or direct soil degradation label.

lai_lv.name: Leaf area index, low vegetation
lai_lv.caveat: ERA5-Land LAI is prescribed as a repeating monthly climatology. Seasonal variation cannot establish observed interannual greening, recovery, or degradation. Separate satellite observations are required for those claims.

lblt.name: Lake bottom temperature
lblt.caveat: Model bottom-water temperature. Lake fields are computed even at cells without lakes; interpret using lake fraction CL. Lake area and depth are fixed in time, so this field does not measure Aral Sea shrinkage.

licd.name: Lake ice depth
licd.caveat: Ice thickness, not water depth or lake-area coverage. Use lake fraction CL to identify modeled inland water. ECMWF's fractional ice treatment reaches full ice coverage at 0.10 m thickness.

u10.name: 10 m eastward wind component
u10.caveat: Signed eastward velocity is not scalar wind speed. Speed requires both u10 and v10: sqrt(u10^2 + v10^2). Magnitude of daily mean components is not the daily mean of hourly speeds.

cl.name: Lake cover
cl.caveat: Invariant modeled lake fraction. Required for interpreting lake fields, but cannot establish changing observed water extent.

derived-era5-single-levels-daily-statist.name: ERA5 post-processed daily statistics on single levels from 1940 to present

derived-era5-land-daily-statistics.name: ERA5-Land post-processed daily statistics from 1950 to present

aggregation_caveat.text: Daily statistics are computed during retrieval. Audit product identifier, aggregation statistic, source sampling frequency, and UTC offset. Available sampling intervals are 1, 3, or 6 hours. A daily timestamp alone does not establish a 24-sample mean or local-day definition. Grid spacing corroborates identity but is insufficient by itself because data can be interpolated.

aral_mask_caveat.text: ECMWF-affiliated primary research documents that GlobCover2009 represented Aral Sea extent from 1998; updated inland-water fields substantially changed the lake fraction and improved modeled land-surface-temperature predictions around Aral. This supports treating static model masks as a limitation rather than a measure of water-area change.
